rule: FZ10-R01 in listed-bullet order: FAIL, COMPATIBLE, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
reference_models: free tau mass after electron and muon inputs
selection: Earliest first-public release after public registration of this dataset contract of a dedicated experimental charged-tau mass measurement; tie by canonical identifier. Select from metadata before reading value or uncertainty. No world averages, theory estimates, reprints or updated versions of pre-registration results.
admission: After nomination, retain this candidate even if ineligible. Require public source bytes and hashes, first-public timestamp evidence, event/run overlap inventory against exposed measurements, exposure declarations from comparison participants, mass convention, all calibrations and systematic/covariance conventions, and the official combined standard uncertainty. Missing admission inputs yield NOT_READY, not a replacement candidate.
unexpected_exposure: Metadata fields do not guarantee blindness: a title or search snippet may contain a result. Record the person and exposed release, retain that release in chronological nomination, and block its admission. Do not hide the exposure or nominate a later release instead.
nuisance_policy: Use the collaboration's prereported result, calibration and combined standard uncertainty unchanged. Do not fit nuisance parameters to FZ-10, pool results, convert asymmetric intervals silently, assume independent systematics, or reinterpret a confidence limit as a standard uncertainty. Keep the historical FZ-10 electron/muon inputs, center and window fixed; no recalibration to later CODATA editions.
statistic: Absolute distance from the canonical frozen center divided by the reported standard uncertainty; retain a separate full-window robustness assessment. No global chance probability or OPH-versus-Koide evidence ratio.
multiplicity: One nominated release and one charged-tau mass observable; one primary verdict. Component errors and window sensitivity are diagnostics, not additional attempts.
stopping: Stop after that release, including failure, insufficient precision or blocked admission. Do not wait for a favorable update or swap experiments. Publish all outcomes and metadata exclusions. Corrections retain the original outcome and require a separately versioned assessment.
resource: Existing primary public release only; local arithmetic. No hardware, paid data, cloud job or automatic polling is authorized.
blockers: No eligible untouched measurement identified by the bounded metadata discovery; this is not a claim that no unindexed or private result exists.
No selected dataset, run-overlap/exposure inventory or experiment-specific uncertainty/nuisance dossier is available.
This execution contract has no claimed external registration evidence yet; historical FZ-10 custody alone does not freeze a new dataset selection.
